scenarios.name: Increase Emergency Savings
disadvantages: Less money available for other goals
scenarios.risk: Investment opportunities may be delayed while building the emergency reserve.

scenarios.name: Increase Debt Repayment
advantages: May reduce interest burden depending on loan terms
disadvantages: Less money available for savings in the short term
scenarios.risk: Emergency savings should not be completely ignored.

scenarios.name: Long-Term Investment Learning
scenarios.risk: Money invested may lose value and may not be suitable for short-term needs.
